notes.title: Mordesh Life Store Update
notes.notes:
Dressed to Mordesh

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/6b4b8d27df0a5cc2742099450639e6031906e2b5.jpg

The Mordesh may have narrowly escaped an extinction-level viral outbreak followed by an unquestionably inhumane quarantine, but just as art is a reflection of culture, sometimes resilience in the face of tragedy truly inspires statements of high fashion. Now all the hippest crews on Nexus can don the type of garb that says chic yet functional. The materials that were originally manufactured to keep a decomposed Mordesh body intact will now also keep you looking fly, whether on the battle field or in the club. Fashion-forward but eloquently understated, this Mordesh costume even has the soothing aesthetic of cybernetic implants and Vitalus Serum storage compartments.

Contagious Carnivore

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/fe376f85b25c27cc10b8b34ef9ec524ba6d27bbd.jpg

Velocerix have always made for reliable and intimidating mounts—they get you where you need to go while striking fear in the hearts of your enemies. And, overcome with Contagion and surgically enhanced to thrive (life . . . finds a way), this particular Velocirex takes the reptilian brooding to a whole new level.

Modified to Perfection

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/13e9f650c6a598e4e59b8a5d5444a79c2e9833d8.jpg

Whether serving the Dominion or the Exiles, we can probably all agree that Mordesh fashion and technology just looks cool. Combine that unmistakable style with the undeniable cuteness of a baby trask and you’ve got yourself an adorable, must-have companion. Adopt this little tyke now and it’ll enthusiastically follow you to the edge of the galaxy.

Immortal Furnishing

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/52015594797d3a015877228d7a1bea92a63cb546.jpg

To put the ultimate exclamation point on your affinity for all things Mordesh, you’ll want to harness your artful eye for interior decoration. Mordesh décor brings to the home a unique blend of modernity and morbid luxury. And with a well-placed coffin in the bedroom, every slumber will feel eternal!
 

Accessing the Store

Launch the game
Click on the Phineas icon on the bottom left, or press the letter “U” on your keyboard
Most everything on the store can be purchased using either OmniBits (a free currency earned in-game alongside XP) or Protobucks, so get your Protostar-approved items today!


All this icing looking pretty sweet? Then dive in today and get yourself a galaxy-sized slice of WildStar cake—no subscription required.

Gelatin Gatos

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/d9f51927fc7db54e95ca8c54f735fb035a837554.jpg

An unnaturally-vibrant array of Gummilynx mounts are now available on the In-Game Store! The Rapple color is unique to our Signature members as a special limited time preview, but the other Bingberry, Concord, and Loppfruit variations are available for everyone—and (while we don’t condone taking bites of your Gummilynx) will inevitably get caught in your teeth.

notes.title: Skate or Dye Store Update
notes.notes:
Hit the Half-pipe
Signature Preview

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/2b4049827d946fe24dbcc5f00084c469723c157a.jpg

If there’s one thing any trickster daredevil on Nexus might feel is missing from their hoverboard: wheels. Tack on a couple pairs, grease up the ball bearings for pure speed, and you’ll be ready to ride the rails of nostalgia in no time! Starting to wonder why wheels are necessary on a board that hovers in midair? Well, stop thinking so much, ‘cause this Skate-or-Die Hoverboard also comes stacked with fire-breathing exhaust pipes! Again you ask why? Reasons, outrageous reasons!

The Legend of the Chompushanka

You’ve scoured the galaxy in search of mythical menaces. You’ve protected the common folk from threats of bloodthirsty, mangy canids—or so the Protostar would have us believe. You’ve even gone so far as to muddy the realm of scientific fact with questionable urban legend. And now you can wear the proof! Certainly not a fabricated fad piece sitting in piles at every opportunist’s souvenir shop, the Chompushanka Hat lets everyone know you’ve encountered the fabled beast and lived to wear it’s head on your head!

Ocher Dokie

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/4abb7a70dfb3c0139391954f5b077b5f7379d1e7.jpg

Autumn is so on-fleek right now, and there’s no better way to represent than by dying your battle-worn wares in a shade best described as “dead leaf.” Pick up the Luminous Ocher Dye to send a message to allies and enemies alike that you’re a true hero who always runs toward a bloodied fray, and also that you’re partial to adorning yourself with earthy pigments.

Whether you’re staring down the four barrels of Mordechai Redmoon’s blasters, or taking on any other genuinely unpleasant Nexus scum, you want to be jacked to the max. With the Character Boost Bundle, you can jump a new character straight to level 50, and in addition to the bundle of starting gear and consumables, gain an extra five Ability Tier Upgrades and ten AMP Power Upgrades, all at a discounted price on the In-Game Store.

Perhaps you’re just looking for a little extra heat in your competitive fire. Well, stop smacking those Granok together and snag the true spark of the Ability and AMP Bundle. With five upgrade points each, for a discounted price you’ll be smoking in no time.

You can also purchase AMP Power Upgrades individually, or in a set five or ten, and Ability Tier Upgrades individually, or in a set of five or seven. The bigger the bundle, the more OmniBits and Protobucks you save!

notes.title: Redmoon Rising Overview and Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Redmoon Rising Raid Preview

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/3936a2605540eeb48d1cd1f6326ae5a82acfec8a.jpg

The infamous Marauder ship the Redmoon Terror is hulking in low orbit around Nexus, and the best of the best are being summoned to deal with something happening onboard that few know about—but that is almost certainly pirate zombies. It’s pirate zombies everyone. Check out our preview of the first wing of the Redmoon Terror raid, arriving August 17.


Mordechai and Ish’amel Lore Update

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/d81944dbd7ae1ffb48aef0bd0c53894a67536af6.jpg

Before you step foot onto the Redmoon Terror you should learn more about who is sending you there (Ish’amel) and what he’s sending you to confront (Mordechai). Read up on Captain Mordechai Redmoon and Ish’amel the Bloodied in our latest Enemies and Allies Lore Update.


Madame Fay is Going Retro

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/a2d217defd57577b7d6e54437a27331d4da190a8.jpg

Madame Fay has been following all the latest trends, and she’s pretty sure she understands what’s popular: old stuff. She’s packed her Fortunes full of throwbacks and is offering some truly incredible rewards. Check them out in our Madame Fay inventory refresh overview, going live with the Redmoon Rising update on August 17.


Redmoon Terror: The Story So Far

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/67a5afbf6084d088b81369480fdea4108398a2b1.jpg

The Redmoon Terror ship floats in the sky above Nexus, and Ish’amel the Bloodied has called on adventurers to help deal with the threat onboard. But what led us to this point? Get a background on the storied history of Laveka the Dark-Hearted and Mordechai Redmoon in our Story So Far recap.


WildStar Redmoon Rising Patch Notes

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/f7f11b4122484b18b668a4d60bcfffe471cb5e1b.jpg

General

PTRCopy should now be more reliable.
All Expeditions, Adventures, and level-50 World Story Instances will now offer Glory in place of Renown. Glory payouts in dungeons have also been re-balanced in an attempt to provide more normalized payouts, taking into consideration the varying difficulties and completion times.
Fixed a spell system crash (sometimes seen with Medic Rune Set "Scourge").
Mail can now be sent to characters of the opposing faction.


Character

Item Specials

Fixed an issue in which Enrage would not apply if the player has Interrupt Armor.


Items

Mounts

The Trans Nex Phoenix hoverboard and its flair set are no longer tagged Unique.






Classes

View class changes on the WildStar official site in the full 1.6.0 patch notes.

Content

Arcterra

Frozen Lopp creatures will now provide a bit less Soulfrost when destroyed.


Contracts

Contract Agents are now offering new wares to players for a Promissory Note cost. Speak to them to acquire Runecrafting materials, Foci, and new limited-time offers.


Malgrave

Bluff Murgh should no longer exhibit strange movement patterns while engaged in combat.


Quests

Updated the location link for the Hell is Empty imbuement quest so that it points to the entrance to Sim Core G-33.


Wilderrun

Fixed a bug causing feralclaw cubs to spawn when a character resurrects outside Wilderrun during the quest “Taming the Wilds.”




Adventures

Crimelords of Whitevale

Fixed a bug that could cause the Welcome to Thermock Hold episode to appear incomplete in the Content Finder.




PVP

Battlegrounds

Halls of the Bloodsworn

Removed the points from the Halls of the Bloodsworn Galactic Hotshot achievements that are no longer attainable.
Fixed an issue that was preventing Scrapper of the Halls from counting player kills in Halls of the Bloodsworn: Reloaded.
Corrected the description for Scrapper of the Halls to reflect that kills on any Control Point counts towards achievement progress.
Retired the Controlling Interest achievement.






Raids

Flares should now be usable again in raids.


Economy

In-Game Store

Items sold within the store that are character bound can now be mailed to an alternate character on that account.


Items

Rune Sets

Runecrafting recipes have been added for Risen (iLvl 140) class and generic Rune sets.
Runecrafting recipes have been added for to upgrade Pure and Divine class sets to Risen versions of those sets. These upgraded runes will grant 3 Power each.
Glance and Glance Mitigation bonuses have been adjusted to match the new balance for those stats.
Mecha Shield

8-Power set bonus now increases the duration of Personal Defense Unit by 2 seconds instead of refunding a charge on activating Provocation ExoSuit.




Runes

Mountain

The Armor bonus now scales dynamically with Max Health instead of snapshotting.








Housing

Attempting to unlock a housing sky or housing music item you already own should now give you a more appropriate error message.
Fixed issue where pre-dyed items on mannequins were not preserving the dye.
Fixed issue where multiple decor delete confirm windows could be created but only one could be used.
Decor

The Illuminated Window (Protostar) is now available for sale from the housing vendor.




Itemization

Risen Rune Foci have been added to the supply satchel. Along with this change, display order in the supply satchel for Rune Foci have been updated to show all Runes of a similar tier together.
Items that are ilvl 130 or above will now only have a max of 3 Rune Slots.
Gadgets

Gadget specials for Brace for Impact and Safeguard now apply Recently Shielded, which prevents the application an absorb shield from these gadget specials for 30 seconds.
Gadgets are now consistent in the way they interact with Stealth. Gadgets do not break Stealth unless they cause damage to foes.
Deathmark debuff can now be applied up to 150m away. This change is due to needing to be within 40m of the center of a creature to trigger the gadget, as the distance became misleading on larger creatures with large hit boxes.
Activating a gadget should no longer interrupt your active spell casts.




User Interface

Addons

Account Inventory

Added searching by name alphabetical sorting.


Group Frames

Improved the string shown to members of a group when another member's kick or invite permissions are changed.


Tooltips

Visibility settings for Unit Tooltips have been added to the Interface Options.


Vendor

Now supports account currency vendor prices.






Installation/Launcher

Installing through Steam was incorrectly requiring 20 GB of free disk space after initial download. This requirement has been lowered to 5 GB.
Reduced occurrence of "Client/Server Mismatch" error during patching process.

notes.title: 1.5.4 Game Update Notes - 14 July 2016
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/1189e094d6cbaff2e8204a18611ef2e1b0bcc698.jpg

The latest update for WildStar brings a meteoric-ton of new features and system refinements.

Heroes Evolved Patch Highlights

Level 50 Boost
Purchase and create level-50 characters, allowing you to quickly add a new alt or catch up to your friends, and jump directly to max-level content.
Multi-Queuing
Queue up for multiple types of instanced content, either solo or as a group.
Cross-Faction Instances
Faction restrictions for Dungeons, Expeditions, Practice Arenas, and Battlegrounds have been removed.
New Race/Class Combinations
Two new race/class combinations—Chua Warrior and Aurin Engineer—can be purchased and unclocked from the In-Game Store.
Race and Gender Changes
Change your character’s race or gender at the Chop Shop vendors found in-game.
Path Master
You can now learn and level up additional Paths, and switch between them at any time.
More Account-Wide Offerings
Protostar Promissory Notes and a number of AMP and Ability Tier Points are now account-wide and able to be used by any of your characters.
Enhanced Arcterra Rewards
Arcterra Soulfrost vendors now have enhanced gear and rewards to help players better prepare for veteran expeditions, dungeons, and raids.
Check out the full patch notes below.


1.5.4 Game Update Notes

Multi-Queue

Implemented queuing for multiple types of matchmaking queues simultaneously.
Improved the average wait time calculation for matchmaking.
Fixed an error which could occasionally cause a player to remain in a World Story instance (such as OMNICore-1) after leaving the instance group.
Fixed a bug which could occasionally cause the client to stop queuing after leaving an unfinished game.
Fixed a bug affecting visibility of lore collectibles (Journals, Tales From Beyond the Fringe, Datacubes) in instanced content.
Changed the matchmaking penalty system from a spell debuff which prevents queueing to a queue time penalty system.
Fixed a bug which occasionally prevented players from being able to teleport back into match finder games after disconnecting.


General

Purchasing Steam packages for WildStar will now properly award Cosmic Reward Points.
Added pluralization support to the currency name when you don't have enough source currency and the conversion requires more than one of that currency.
Fixed an issue when changing races that caused race-specific appearance options to show up on the new race until relogging.


Character

Customization

Changing your face style now also allows you to customize it for free! Now you are free to make your face look how you want it.
Race description tooltips will now be shown for all races of the selected faction, instead of only the currently selected race.
Added indication of purchasable classes in the Race Description popup.




Holo-Wardrobe

Fixed a bug that prevented the full area of the "Unlock Costume Item" button in the confirmation window from being clickable.
Fixed dye buttons for swimwear in Holo-Wardrobe so they are not selectable as intended.


Items

Mounts

The Box Promo Snarfelynx will no longer be Account Bound. You can once again trade this between accounts or sell it on the Auction House.




Classes

AMPs

The following AMP Power Upgrades are now Account Tradeable. This means you can unlock them on one character and then send additional copies to your alts. Each character is still restricted to the 1-use limit per item.

Shiphand's AMP Power Upgrade
Crimson Badlands AMP Power Upgrade
Northern Wastes AMP Power Upgrade
Star-Comm Station AMP Power Upgrade
Prestigious AMP Power Upgrade 1
Renowned AMP Power Upgrade




Ability Tier Point Unlocks

The following Ability Tier Point Unlocks are now Account Tradeable. This means you can unlock them on one character and then send additional copies to your alts. Each character is still restricted to the 1-use limit per item.

Adventurer's Ability Tier Point Unlock
Blighthaven Ability Tier Point Unlock
The Defile Ability Tier Point Unlock
Prestigious Ability Tier Point Unlock 1
Renowned Ability Tier Point Unlock






Content

Achievements

Added achievements for Explorers, Scientists, Settlers, and Soldiers who reach Path level 30, and one for characters who reach level 30 in all Paths.


Arcterra

The Arctic Shredder Mount should now have an appropriate icon.
The "Fate of the Frozen" event now displays a timer showing when it will return.
Players may now immediately log out from the Sanctuary portion of Shiverskull Tower. Additionally, when hanging out in the opposite faction's area, the timer will now start at 10 seconds, rather than 5.
All item-level-85 armor and weapons from Arcterra have been updated with a new imbuement to further increase their item level by 5.
The vendors in Arcterra have acquired new wares. Speak to your faction's Soulfrost Vendor to obtain the new imbuement items needed to power up your existing gear. In addition, be sure to visit the Reputation vendor for your Pure Class Foci and an Arcterra-exclusive Ability Point.
The drop rates for the Icebound Pouch have been improved slightly in favor of receiving non-décor items.


Vault of the Archon

The Arcterra Ability Point now has a chance to drop upon gold medal completion.


Contracts

Added support for Account Currency quest rewards.
Protostar Promissory Notes will now stack to 1000.
Any remaining "Pouches of Promissory Notes" and "Overflowing Pouches of Promissory Notes" have been removed from the game. Affected players will receive in-game mail containing an appropriate amount of Promissory Notes
All contracts will now award players with a new Promissory Note account currency that will function similarly to the previous items, but will be usable by any character on the account.


Star-Comm Basin

Events should start with more regularity now.




Dungeons

Fixed an issue that prevented some grouped players from interacting with the lockbox at the end of a dungeon.


PVP

Arenas

Lead can now be transferred between team members.




Paths

Added Path unlocking and Path switching to the Path Log UI.
Fixed an issue that was causing characters created at level 50 to not receive Tier 2 of their Path spells.


Economy

Protostar Promissory Notes are now an account level currency that can be spent at all of the reputation conversion NPCs across Nexus on any character on your account.
In-Game Store

Fixed a bug which could occasionally cause store banners to not load properly.
Fixed errors around banner fetching/loading.
The bind-to-character confirmation dialog will no longer be shown for account currency purchases or account level unlocks.
Window will no longer close when following the store link on Service Token prompt.




Housing

Décor

Items from the Summer Décor Pack should now be Account Tradeable.


FABkit

The underground casino portion of the underground casino FABkit no longer displays "Creepy Cave." In addition, the mini-map no longer displays gray.
The underground casino no longer takes you to a new instance, but a new underground area of the housing plot. The interior may also be decorated as well.




Itemization

Items that new characters start with that bind on equip or acquire will now be Soulbound upon character creation.
Gadgets

Fixed a bug that caused gadgets in the inventory to have the restricted icon overlay even though all requirements were met.




User Interface

Addons

Account Inventory

There are now filters for Consumables, Toys, and Loot Bags. Filtering presentation and logic have also been revised.


Character

Faction indicator when inspecting other players now uses their base faction rather than current faction.


Chat

The "Advice" channel has been renamed to "Nexus" and is now available to all players on the realm (including those of the opposite faction)! The /a shortcut may still be used to access the Nexus channel in addition to /n and /nexus. Localized versions of this channel have been similarly renamed from AdviceFrench and AdviceGerman to NexusFrench and NexusGerman, respectively.


Chop Shop

Fixed an issue that caused characters to be displayed without underwear when changing race in the Character Chop Shop while the Chest and Leg armors were hidden.


Circuitboard Crafting

Crafting windows will now interrupt Mouse Look mode when invoked.


Comm-Display

Added support for Account Currency quest rewards.
Fixed a Lua error which could occur when using the Communicator to call a quest giver for an achieved quest with no fixed rewards.


Dialog

Added support for Account Currency quest rewards.


Matchmaker

When affected by a queue penalty, the time in queue will appear red and have a tooltip explaining the penalty.
The "Join the Fight" button will be disabled when in a group that is queued as a group for matchmaking.
The Quests tab will now initialize properly in all instances.


Mini-map

Players can now access their queue status window from the Mini-map when queued for a match.


Quest Log

Added support for Account Currency quest rewards.


Welcome Window

Fixed an error that happened when a bonus event updated while the window was loading.


Apollo API

Path Mission

Fixed an issue that required a double-click on a Path Mission that was already selected in order to show the Hint arrow.




Chat Log

Player chat from the opposite faction will no longer be substituted with the alien language.
Hostile player names will now appear red in the chat log when speaking in public chat channels.

notes.title: Heroes Evolved Update on PTR
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23645541/1189e094d6cbaff2e8204a18611ef2e1b0bcc698.jpg

Hey all, Pappy here!

It’s been an awesome few weeks for WildStar. As you probably know, we released on Steam on June 9, welcoming a bunch of crazy new kids to the WildStar family. Then last week we updated the game with some new PvP quests, additional lighting improvements, and some brand-spankin’ new shinies at Madame Fay’s Fortunes. Throw in there ten super-fun days of Space Chase, the continuing Starfall anniversary festivities, a new DevConnect, and you’ve got a full slate of delicious WildStar goodness.

But guess what? We ain’t done. Our next content update—Heroes Evolved—has just been released on the PTR, and it’s jam packed with exciting new systems and features that give you more choices on what you play, how you play, and who you play with! With Redmoon Terror and other new content set to release over the next few months, many of these features are focused on getting you prepared for more epic adventures on Nexus (and making sure that you look good doing it). Here are some of the highlights:
 
Creating Level 50s: Players can purchase and create level-50 characters, allowing them to jump directly into max-level content. These characters will provide you with all of the necessary gear and system upgrades, along with some additional goodies to make sure you’re prepped for your big adventure on Nexus.
Multi-Queuing: This long-awaited feature will allow you to queue up for multiple instances, either solo or as a group. We’re excited to get this feature out there, but we’re going to need your help testing it and getting it ready to go. More info on that (and a special reward if you do) below.
New Race/Class Combinations: We’re adding two new race/class combinations to WildStar—Chua Warrior and Aurin Engineer. Sword-wielding space hamsters and gun-toting tree huggers are finally here!
Race and Gender Changes: You’ll be able to change your race and gender inside the Chop Shop in this update. Been wanting to change that battle-scarred Draken Male into a highborn Cassian female? Don’t let your dreams be dreams.
Path Master: You’ll also be able to learn and level up additional Paths, and switch between them any time you want. Become a super-smart explorer who likes to build stuff and blow it up at the same time!
More Account-Wide Offerings: We’re making Protostar Promissory Notes (reputation turn-in items) into an account-wide currency that can be used by all of your characters, along with making a number of AMP and Ability Tier Points account tradeable. Altaholics assemble!
Enhanced Arcterra Rewards: We are releasing some enhanced gear and other rewards to the Arcterra Soulfrost vendors, allowing players to get better prepared for veteran expeditions, dungeons and raids.
As I said above, the Heroes Evolved update is now live on the PTR and ready for you to help us test it. And if you do, you could get a Battlesworn costume back in the live game. We need to put the new multi-queuing feature through its paces, and we’re going to need your help. We’ll be organizing community playtests of the multi-queuing feature on the PTR, and those who participate during the specified times will be rewarded (along with the personal satisfaction that you have contributed to the success of one of WildStar’s coolest new features). Head over here for the details.

Last but not least, don’t forget that the Redmoon Terror—WildStar’s next raid—is also coming in August, along with some other new and exciting content that we’ll be announcing in the coming weeks. Stay tuned!

I want to end this update by giving a special shout out to the WildStar community for your passion and continued support. You have all really stepped up to help all of our new players, and have created a fun and welcoming environment where everyone can enjoy all the great things that the game has to offer. Team WildStar sends out a heartfelt “Thank You!” for your efforts.

See you all on Nexus!

Pappy
